items.name: Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens A - 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBczJJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6d41a95dbcd2b6c177ccb028ad973065c128a8aa/reunion%202024.jpg) [](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnA1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--07e81cdd5b508271bf1d27c0c873b462bead0340/image.png) **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Α μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. Ο 3x3 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα 4x4 και Clock ή 2x2 και OH επιθυμείτε. Μετά από τις διακοπές θα βρεθούμε ξανά για τον πρώτο διαγωνισμό της νέας σεζόν! Ελάτε να περάσουμε όμορφα για ακόμα μία φορά στον γνωστό πλέον χώρο του Rubicon. Σας περιμένουμε στο **Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens 2024 - A. ** Αγωνίσματα Α' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 4x4 * Clock Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) **Note:** This competition is part A of a series of two competitions. You can participate in **only one of the two**. 3x3 is in both contests so choose carefully which day or which of 4x4 and Clock or 2x2 and OH you prefer. After the holidays we will meet again for the first competition of the new season! Come and have a good time once again at the famous Rubicon venue. We are waiting for you in **Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens 2024 - A.** Competition Α events: * 3x3 * 4x4 * Clock Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.name: Don't DNS Denton 2024
items.information: ##### **This is not a normal competition with common events like 3x3 and 2x2. This competition features "quiet" and less common events, including the main event, 3x3 Fewest Moves, which offers 9 attempts total. For a more normal competition experience, check out the [many other competitions happening in Texas](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=USA&search=Texas&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&show_registration_status=on&display=list).** This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/). - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DontDNSDenton2024#46556-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DontDNSDenton2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).

items.name: Ottawa Favourites 2024
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## [EN] ### Registration Reminders Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video expains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). Please see tabs for more information about the competition. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Comme il s'agit là d'une compétition de type "favoris", **vous pouvez choisir au maximum quatre (4) épreuves**. Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: **REGISTRO** A participação nesta competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 35 e o pagamento deverá ser feito via PIX para a chave planeta.rio.open@gmail.com. O comprovante de pagamento deverá ser enviado para o mesmo email; 2. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Prestar atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 3. Preencher o seguinte [formulário](https://forms.gle/CKRxrhXte6JPtWmq5) para facilitar o controle dos nomes dos competidores e acompanhantes por parte da equipe do Planetário envolvida com a organização; 4. Para obterem a entrada e permanência na competição, os **acompanhantes** deverão adquirir os ingressos na bilheteria do Planetário. Cada competidor terá direito a 2 acompanhantes grátis e mais dois pagando meia entrada (R$10), isso caso a inscrição seja realizada até dia 5 de setembro. Os demais acompanhantes, se houver, deverão pagar o valor inteiro do ingresso (R$20) para entrada. **Esta taxa é aplicada somente aos acompanhantes e deverá ser paga apenas nos dias da competição, não devendo ser feita junto a transferência PIX para o pagamento da inscrição**; 5. Para informações adicionais, verifique o site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do email planeta.rio.open@gmail.com, bem como o delegado por meio do email gmello@worldcubeassociation.org ou isoares@worldcubeassociation.org; 6. Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. **REGISTRATION** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Register through the WCA website. The registration costs R$35 and must be paid via PIX transfer to planeta.rio.open@gmail.com. Proof of payment must be sent to the same email address; 2. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind; 3. Fill in the following [form](https://forms.gle/CKRxrhXte6JPtWmq5) to help keep track of competitor and guest names by the Planetarium team involved with the organization; 4. To gain entry and stay in the competition, **companions** must purchase tickets at the Planetarium box office. Each competitor will be entitled to 2 free companions and two more for half price (R$10), if registration is completed by September 5th. Other companions, if any, must pay the entire ticket price (R$20) for entry. **This fee is only applied to companions and must only be paid on the days of the competition, and must not be made together with the PIX transfer to pay for registration**; 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (planeta.rio.open@gmail.com), or the delegate ( gmello@worldcubeassociation.org or isoares@worldcubeassociation.org); 6. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

items.name: Sandnes Open 2024
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 170kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Sandnes Open 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 170 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition.
